title: Start With the Way You Already Work
description: Get time back without adding a second job. Use the notes and photos you already keep, then review and confirm your records in three simple steps.

steps.title: Set Up Your Farm
steps.description: Start your free trial and visually organize your farm, fields, plots, and subplots the way you know them. No credit card required.

steps.title: Say It, Snap It
steps.description: Say what happened or photograph a paper log. AI helps structure the entry; you review and confirm before saving.

steps.title: Review, Confirm, Report
steps.description: Choose your field records and compliance forms or templates to generate reports. Review, confirm, and share reports and data.
